description:
## Origin

Pass 8 spec reconciliation (2026-05-18, commit 84d7310) ran §13.13 criterion 4 drift sweep across all 4 registered consumer workspaces. Drift was significant in every workspace (canonical-source-advance accreted across Arcs 38+39+40+41 + Pass 8 spec-recon):

| Workspace | DRIFTED | MISSING | OBSOLETE |
|---|---|---|---|
| ariadne-core-workspace | 17 | 10 | 0 |
| railway_stoa | 19 | 11 | 0 |
| sector-4 | 19 | 11 | 0 |
| the-stoa (substrate-authoring; project-tier) | 17 | 10 | 0 |

PRINCIPAL ratified option (a) "apply to the-stoa only now; defer others to separate sessions" at 2026-05-18.

**the-stoa workspace** completed: `bash substrate/install.sh --target project --project-dir /c/Users/denso/claude_projects/the-stoa` committed at 51e0b9f. Post-install check.sh returns 0 drifted / 0 missing / 0 obsolete; §13.13 criterion 4 satisfied at the substrate-authoring tier.

**Three workspaces still pending**: ariadne-core-workspace + railway_stoa + sector-4.

## Plan per workspace

For each of the 3 deferred workspaces:

1. Open separate user-tier POLYBIUS session in that workspace's parent directory (so apply.sh can access workspace .claude/).
2. Run `bash <the-stoa>/substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/check.sh --workspace <workspace-path>` to enumerate current drift.
3. Run `bash <the-stoa>/substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/apply.sh --workspace <workspace-path> --all-differing --yes` for DRIFTED files (apply.sh handles pre-commit safety net + commit-then-overwrite semantics).
4. Run `bash <the-stoa>/substrate/install.sh --target project --project-dir <workspace-path>` for MISSING files (new substrate files since last apply).
5. Re-run check.sh to verify clean state.
6. Inspect for any apply.sh warnings about role-files-modified-while-agent-running (those may indicate PRINCIPAL or another agent has the workspace open with active session).

If any deployed file has PRINCIPAL-authored local edits (not substrate-canonical), apply.sh `--yes` mode auto-commits-then-overwrites + preserves the local-edit via git history per the SKILL.md spec. PRINCIPAL can `git revert` the auto-commit's overwrite if desired.

## Why deferred (not blocking spec-met)

§13.13 criterion 4 ("No substrate drift — check-substrate-updates shows source-canon-and-deployed-instances byte-equal across consumer workspaces (including user-tier post-bj5 ship per Arc 38 C2)") is the spec-met gate.

For the make-the-team-meet-the-spec sequence specifically, only the-stoa's deployed substrate is operationally relevant for the Pass 10 stellation dispatch (stellation runs fresh install.sh against a new ~/claude_projects/stellation/ workspace; ariadne/sector-4/railway aren't involved in the validation). So this ticket is **NOT a blocker for spec-met**; it's a hygiene gap that should close before/during Pass 10 or as part of routine post-spec-met substrate-deploy maintenance.

If Pass 9 mech-check explicitly enforces "all 4 workspaces drift-clean" rather than just the-stoa, then this ticket becomes a Pass 9 blocker and the apply sessions need to land before Arc 42 ships.

## Sequencing

P3. After Pass 9 mech-check is authored (Arc 42), evaluate whether the validate-spec skill requires all 4 workspaces drift-clean. If yes: prioritize this ticket to close before Arc 42 ship. If no: ship sometime post-spec-met as routine substrate maintenance.

- 51e0b9f — the-stoa project-tier .claude/ deploy (substrate-authoring tier satisfied)
- SPECIFICATION.md §13.13 criterion 4 (spec-met gate)
- SPECIFICATION.md §13.9a (post-sequence-surfaced tickets bucket; this ticket adds to bucket)
- substrate/consumer-workspaces.txt (registered workspace list)
